description.value:
Cuisine has toppled governments and fed rebellions alike, and the Chef understands better than anyone that a meal can be as potent a tool as any blaster. Those drawn to this pursuit study the chemistry of flavor and nutrition the way others study starship engines, turning the kitchen into a laboratory.

In the field, a Chef's cooking becomes something closer to alchemy, capable of fortifying a squad, curing the sick, or quietly undoing an enemy from the inside. What arrives on the plate is never simply food.
